About AeroGate International Hub

A world-class aviation crossroads serving over 45 million passengers across 120 global destinations annually.

Our Infrastructure & Mission

AeroGate International is designed as an ultra-modern smart airport integrating automated biometric border control, high-efficiency baggage sortation, and next-generation passenger experience systems. Operating across 3 dedicated terminals and 4 parallel runways, AeroGate connects major continents with 98.4% on-time flight departure reliability.
